summary.headline: Your new website, booking page and newsletter are approved and ready to launch.
summary.body: Done: your logo and Honey and Rose brand board are picked, the old website address forwards to floridaretirementstrategies.com, and the first issue of The Weekly is approved. Next: the full website goes live, The Weekly goes out Tuesday, Nov 24 at 9 AM, and a Thanksgiving greeting follows Wednesday. Still open: business texting registration, Facebook access from Creative One, and new photos of Maria.
summary.needs_you: Yilian: add carrier and social media logins to the password vault and upload Maria's photos to the Assets folder. Maria: save outfit screenshots for Yilian, register the DBA and book a photo shoot after your trip. Both: pick a Google Workspace plan and approve the Thanksgiving greeting.
summary.next_call: Thu, Dec 3, 10:30 AM ET (9:30 AM CT)

tasks.note: It finds the news, writes each issue in Maria's voice and saves a draft for approval. On the Nov 5 call we agreed on about four sections each week, built from your own resource library. Nothing goes to subscribers on its own. Maria shared more newsletter ideas by email on Nov 10 and 11.

tasks.note: Each tip is confirmed against official FRS pages before it can be used. Agreed on Nov 19: for the first 30 to 60 days we double check the facts in each issue.

tasks.task: First newsletter sent from GHL
tasks.note: Maria approved it on the Nov 19 call. It goes out Tuesday, Nov 24 at 9 AM.

tasks.note: All notes moved into GHL. Account documents are saved in our secure Google Drive.

tasks.note: The 15-minute intro call calendar and booking page are ready and book onto the right calendar. Maria and Yilian checked it. It goes live with the new website, replacing Calendly.

tasks.task: Appointment reminders and no-show follow-up
tasks.note: Confirmation, reminders 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before, a thank-you after the call, and up to 3 messages offering a new time after a missed call. Turned on Nov 17 and ready for launch.

tasks.task: AI phone assistant and missed-call text back
Lead and client follow-up journeys
tasks.note: Nov 5: the first new-lead follow-up is built: ads and posts in English and Spanish lead to a short form and a booked call. Nov 9: Maria sent the text messages she already uses. Nov 17: the step that asks each lead to confirm their call is turned on. Nov 19: ready to launch with the website.

tasks.note: Agreed on the Nov 5 call as a next priority. We will check with F and G, North American and Nationwide whether they can let us know when a policy is approved, so the portal invite goes out on its own.
